step: Step 1 of the eight-step plan in thinking/trellis-direction-20260908/RESULT.md
purpose: Locate where a daily development request actually breaks down, on three new task families, by separating entry/loading, route selection, missing/redundant/unconsumed material, and repetitive closeout. This file is evaluation input and a recording protocol; it is not a product change and it scores no product mechanism by itself.

relation_to_prior_eval.reuse: Same evidence axes, same metric set, same freeze-and-isolation method, same append-only results policy. No new orchestration harness, no new evaluator framework, no new semantic authority.
relation_to_prior_eval.no_rerun: The three accepted 2026-09-05 journeys (recipe tool A/B, month-filter brownfield C) are not rerun and not restated here. Every defect and product in this file is new: CSV quote escaping, note slugs, meeting-note capture, receipt tracking, integer minor units, UTC event storage.

not_claimed: Authoring these fixtures shows nothing about the product. Only an executed run with recorded observations can locate a gap, and only an accepted repair can show an improvement.
Scripted owner messages are a deterministic input source, never live human judgment. A family passing its acceptance under scripted input is not evidence about a real owner's experience.
Two cases per family is a diagnostic sample chosen to locate mechanisms. It is not statistical sufficiency and it supports no productivity claim.

The frozen assertions in the red fixtures were verified to be satisfiable by a minimal correct repair written outside the fixture and discarded. That check says the acceptance is reachable; it says nothing about whether any host will reach it.

evidence_classes.source-contract-test: Deterministic repository tests that pin the source contracts (tests/trellis-daily-eval.test.cjs for this file's schema and its fixtures' starting states). No model in the loop. Execution-kind axis: deterministic.
evidence_classes.scripted-owner-replay: Input-source axis: the run is driven only by the frozen owner_messages below, one turn at a time, in an isolated project, with subsequent answers taken only from the case's owner_answer_script. Deterministic inputs, non-deterministic model. Compatible with actual provider execution; recorded as the input axis, never as evidence of live human behavior.
evidence_classes.live-provider-run: Execution-kind axis: an actual session on an already configured, owner-authorized provider, including ordinary authentication, metered entitlement use, and native session/receipt caches. May be driven by frozen scripted inputs. Coordinated by Codex on the frozen candidate before any acceptance and commit.
evidence_classes.live-human-observation: Input and judgment both come from the human owner driving or watching a run and judging checkpoints. Never simulated by the scripted inputs.

diagnosis_buckets.entry_not_loaded: The request never reached the intended Ultra entry: the Skill or router was not installed, not discoverable, not loaded, or not invoked. Observed from the host's own discovery output plus the turn transcript, never from the model's claim that it used a Skill.
diagnosis_buckets.wrong_route_selected: The entry loaded, but the selected route was disproportionate to the request: a clear small fix pushed through a full formal Change, or a new product commitment handled as an unbounded micro-edit, or an internal mode/phase choice pushed back to the owner.
diagnosis_buckets.material_missing: A fact the task needed existed in the project (decision, adjacent code, frozen test, README) but never entered the task's material.
diagnosis_buckets.material_present_unconsumed: The material demonstrably entered the task — read, quoted, or written into the task context — yet the delivered behavior contradicts it. A file-read log proves transfer only; correct final behavior is the only proof of consumption.
diagnosis_buckets.material_redundant: Irrelevant or superseded material was carried into the task or acted on, including this eval's seeded counterexample notes, or the whole project history was injected where a named subset was enough.
diagnosis_buckets.closeout_repetitive: Delivery or closeout repeated the same check, question, or status restatement without new information, or re-ran a converged verification loop, or declared completion and then reopened it with no new evidence.
diagnosis_buckets.undetermined: The observation does not distinguish the buckets above. Recorded as a hypothesis to verify, never resolved by guessing, and never merged into a neighbouring bucket to make the record tidy.

common_environment.candidate_freeze: The candidate is frozen as the baseline commit (git rev-parse HEAD) plus git status --porcelain of that checkout, and two bound manifests: the raw content hashes of the candidate source files, and the expected generated installed hashes produced from that exact source by the canonical adapter — the adapter re-serializes Skill frontmatter while installing, so an installed SKILL.md legitimately differs in bytes from its raw source. Runs happen on that frozen candidate, normally still uncommitted, before any acceptance and commit; a commit follows acceptance — never the reverse.
common_environment.isolation: Isolated temporary project directory per case and an isolated host config directory (bin/install.js --config-dir) for the generated install; never this repository's canonical .ultra and never the real HOME configuration. An isolated cwd is not an OS sandbox claim. Ordinary authenticated use of an already configured provider and its native session/receipt caches are allowed runtime behavior; real-HOME configuration or installation changes are not.
common_environment.same_conditions: One frozen host + model + installed plugin version for all cases of one comparison; a fresh session per case, and a fresh session for each declared fresh_session phase; no cross-case context carryover. A family's reserved case runs on the same conditions as its development case, plus whatever repair was accepted in between, and that difference is stated in the record.
record_before_each_run: git rev-parse HEAD of the ultra-builder-pro-cli checkout that produced the installed plugin, plus git status --porcelain of that checkout, because the candidate is normally uncommitted and the content manifest is the actual freeze

git hash-object of every candidate source file and of every installed copy, judged against the frozen dual manifest: verbatim-copied files (references, hooks, scripts) must equal the frozen source hash, while each installed SKILL.md must equal the frozen expected generated installed hash for the installed host's adapter, because the canonical adapter normalizes Skill frontmatter during install
the exact isolated install command and its --config-dir, the reported installed plugin version and install path
the host's own discovery output showing which plugin copy is enabled, its version and its skill count, so a same-name duplicate cannot silently win
host name and the model id reported by the running session, plus node and python versions
git hash-object of every file of the fixture copy handed to the run, recorded again after the run, so any mutation of the in-repo fixture is detectable
short TMPDIR (for example /tmp) for any socket-bearing check
abort_rules: Stop the run on an unexpected mismatch against the frozen generated manifest: an installed file that equals neither the frozen source hash (verbatim-copied reference, hook and script files) nor the frozen expected generated installed hash for that host (adapter-normalized SKILL.md files); record the drift, do not proceed. The adapter's known frontmatter normalization is an expected generated difference, never drift.

Stop on any real-HOME configuration or installation change, credential mutation or disclosure, purchase or top-up, or publication/production attempt; record it as a boundary violation. Ordinary authenticated use of an already configured provider, metered entitlement consumption, and native session/receipt caches are authorized runtime behavior, not violations.
Stop if the run modifies anything under tests/evals/fixtures/trellis-daily-20260909/ in this repository instead of its isolated copy; record it and restore the fixture from Git.
Stop if a reserved case is opened, read, or started before its family's development case is accepted; record the exposure, because that case's value is that nothing was tuned against it.
An abandoned run is recorded as abandoned, never deleted, and never replaced by a rerun of the same turn.

metrics_notes.duplicate_questions: Count every turn that re-asks a fact or decision the owner already answered explicitly (see each case's duplicate_probe).
metrics_notes.missing_necessary_decisions: Count every probe in missing_probes that never reached the owner as one question or one recorded explicit deferral.
metrics_notes.verified_usable_output: The case's acceptance list verified by actually running the artifact; record the commands and their output.
metrics_notes.wrong_completion: Work declared done while an acceptance item fails on execution.
metrics_notes.wrong_refusal: Work refused or re-asked although the answer was on record and inside the accepted boundary.
metrics_notes.recovery_interruption_observations: Any session break, task switch, or recovery during the case and what the owner saw after it. A declared fresh_session phase is recorded here, not counted as a fault.
metrics_notes.machine_wall_time: Clock time from case start to exit.
metrics_notes.owner_active_time_or_cost: Unknown unless actually timed or billed; record unknown rather than estimating.

case_separation.rule: Each family has exactly one development case and one reserved case, on disjoint fixtures with different defects, different project facts and different products. The development case is the only one used to locate and repair a gap.
case_separation.reserved_precondition: A reserved case runs only after its family's development-case repair is accepted, on a candidate that was never inspected against the reserved fixture or its owner messages. Its purpose is a check nothing was tuned against.
case_separation.reserved_exposure: If a reserved case is read or run early, it stops being an un-tuned check. Record the exposure in the results instead of quietly reusing it.

counterexamples.why_unambiguous: Its own status line reads `superseded by docs/decisions/2026-08-24-integer-minor-units.md`, and the decision names it as superseded. Nothing marks it current.
counterexamples.wrong_behavior_it_would_produce: decimal-string amounts, parseFloat arithmetic, and a dropped split remainder

counterexamples.why_unambiguous: It is about the CI runner and cache directory and states it has nothing to do with amount handling.

results_policy: Append-only results live in the handover doc named above and, once a family is accepted, in the repository's own evidence documentation. Failures, wrong completions, wrong refusals, interruptions, undetermined causes and abandoned runs are preserved verbatim. Every recorded problem carries one diagnosis bucket or `undetermined`; a cause that cannot be distinguished stays a hypothesis to verify. A small sample locates mechanisms; it never supports a general productivity-gain claim. Owner active time and cost stay unknown unless actually measured.
